MELEE_ATTACKS_1_3.name: Melee Attacks 1-3
MELEE_ATTACKS_1_3.description: Improves eligible melee weapons; level 2 needs Lair, level 3 needs Hive, plus previous level.

MISSILE_ATTACKS_1_3.name: Missile Attacks 1-3
MISSILE_ATTACKS_1_3.description: Improves eligible ranged ground weapons; same tier progression. Does not automatically improve every damaging spell.

GROUND_CARAPACE_1_3.name: Ground Carapace 1-3
GROUND_CARAPACE_1_3.description: Improves ground armor; same Lair/Hive progression.

FLYER_ATTACKS_1_3.name: Flyer Attacks 1-3
FLYER_ATTACKS_1_3.description: Improves eligible air-unit weapons; level 2 needs Lair, level 3 needs Hive, plus previous level.

FLYER_CARAPACE_1_3.name: Flyer Carapace 1-3
FLYER_CARAPACE_1_3.description: Improves air armor; same tier progression.

BURROW.name: Burrow
BURROW.description: Unlocks ordinary burrow for eligible units. Lurker and other built-in combat modes have their own rules.

PNEUMATIZED_CARAPACE.name: Pneumatized Carapace
PNEUMATIZED_CARAPACE.description: Improves Overlord/Overseer mobility under the matching unit rules.

ADRENAL_GLANDS.name: Adrenal Glands
ADRENAL_GLANDS.description: Improves Zergling attack speed; requires Hive.

CENTRIFUGAL_HOOKS.name: Centrifugal Hooks
CENTRIFUGAL_HOOKS.description: Improves Baneling movement, with additional bonuses varying by patch; requires Lair.

TUNNELING_CLAWS.name: Tunneling Claws
TUNNELING_CLAWS.description: Enables Roach movement while burrowed and associated recovery behavior; requires Lair and Burrow for burrow use.

LUNGE.name: Lunge
LUNGE.description: Unlocks the Hydralisk mobility ability; requires Hive in the installed research table.

ADAPTIVE_TALONS.name: Adaptive Talons
ADAPTIVE_TALONS.description: Improves Lurker burrow/mobility behavior; requires Hive.

SEISMIC_SPINES.name: Seismic Spines
SEISMIC_SPINES.description: Extends Lurker weapon range; requires Hive.

MICROBIAL_SHROUD_RESEARCH.name: Microbial Shroud research
MICROBIAL_SHROUD_RESEARCH.description: Unlocks the shroud in balance versions that gate it behind research. The installed table does not encode this gate reliably; do not infer it is free from that omission.

CHITINOUS_PLATING.name: Chitinous Plating
CHITINOUS_PLATING.description: Improves Ultralisk armor, in addition to the applicable ground-carapace upgrades.

ANABOLIC_SYNTHESIS.name: Anabolic Synthesis
ANABOLIC_SYNTHESIS.description: Improves Ultralisk movement under the upgrade's terrain/creep rules.
